title: Scorecard
description: An arm against another (the base) cell by cell, as suite.py scores them (the catalog's scoring macros): per-seed pairs, the geomean ratio of lag p99 and of wire bytes per useful byte with a 95 % t-interval on a log axis (red higher, blue lower, grey a tie), both arms' absolute geomeans beside, and the collapse counts with a two-sided Fisher p. Structural cells (every arm collapses on every seed it ran) are greyed.
